title: KBProposal
description: A proposed change to the knowledge base, carrying its diff and awaiting a human (S2, B40/D19). S4 is the rule this contract exists to enforce: flywheel writes to the Fact Sheet and Playbook are PROPOSALS WITH A DIFF, never silent commits — the anti-poisoning control, because content that can enter the corpus without a human seeing it is content an attacker (or a confused agent) can plant. Every write door produces one of these: the flywheel router, xlsx import, an in-place card edit, a mint, a deprecation, an outcome back-label. Nothing writes a card directly except the derived-signal path (edit_survival), which changes no content.

status.description: proposed until a steward decides. superseded = a later proposal covers the same ground; nothing is deleted (the v1 governance spine — a rejected proposal is evidence about what the flywheel wanted, and erasing it loses the signal).

source.description: Where the proposal came from — the provenance a steward judges it by. A flywheel proposal carries the events that produced it, so 'why is this being suggested?' is answerable by looking rather than by re-deriving.

door.description: flywheel = routed from feedback events; xlsx_import = a steward's bulk edit; card_edit/mint/deprecate = the curation screen; backlabel = an outcome writing back onto the corpus it drew from; ingestion = a claim candidate the ingestion model flagged in a corpus chunk, auto-drafted as a fact-sheet proposal (P13/C14, the owner's call at B59 — owner/verified_date stay blank until a steward supplies them at acceptance, S4 preserved); assistant = the steward assistant drafting on the operator's instruction (P14/B63) — source.operator carries the human, the door carries the mechanism, and acceptance still runs through the steward inbox like every other door.

operator.description: The authenticated human who opened this door, when a human did. Absent for machine-routed flywheel proposals — the absence is itself the signal that no human has looked yet.

external.description: true = the originating signal came from outside the firm (a guest comment). Kept separable for the same reason actor_role keeps external_reviewer separate: untrusted-provenance signal must never pool with internal.

target.description: The flywheel target this proposal serves — the same vocabulary feedback_event.flywheel_routing.target uses, so a proposal and the event that produced it agree on where the lesson goes.

kind.description: What the proposal would do if accepted.

kb_id.description: The card this concerns, for kinds that concern one.

diff.description: field -> {before, after}. The DIFF is the point (S4): a steward approves a visible change, never a description of one. Computed over parsed models rather than serialized text, so formatting noise never presents as an edit.

note.description: Plain-language reason a reader can act on — why the flywheel or the steward thinks this should change.

decided.description: The steward's disposition. Recorded on the proposal itself so the decision and what was decided never drift apart.
